test_cases.description: Read existing feedback on the demo pull request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the latest Greptile feedback on PR #1 in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes the stored Greptile feedback for the demo PR with the reported code locations. A direct PR lookup or a review/comment lookup is acceptable; identity and repository discovery are only needed if identifiers are missing. Does not start a new review or claim the stored findings were revalidated.

test_cases.description: Start a hosted review and distinguish acceptance from completion.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a new Greptile review of PR #1 in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo.
test_cases.expected_output: Requests one review of the specified demo PR and distinguishes a queued request from a completed review. Checks status; if still running, reports that honestly rather than requiring completion within the conversation. If completed, summarizes the returned result. Repository discovery and additional result lookups are optional as needed. Does not merge or edit the PR.

test_cases.description: Save and retrieve an inactive review rule.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save an inactive custom instruction: Validate pagination limits before reading tasks. Then retrieve the saved instruction and show it to me.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested instruction with status INACTIVE in the demo organization, retrieves the saved record using its returned identifier, and reports its text, identifier, and inactive status. Does not activate the rule or start a review.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find Greptile comments about pagination on PR #1 in greptile-openai-demo/review-demo and explain what they recommend.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds and summarizes pagination-related feedback belonging to the specified demo PR, using a PR lookup, comment listing, or comment search as appropriate. Grounds the explanation in returned comments and code locations. Does not require a published knowledge base, invent findings, or change the PR.

test_cases.description: Read demo review analytics for a fixed period.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show Greptile review activity and findings for greptile-openai-demo/review-demo from September 1 through September 30, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the requested repository and date range with the metrics and findings returned by Greptile. Discovers filter identifiers only when needed. No particular count or finding status is required; clearly reports empty results without inventing activity.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers without invoking Greptile because no connected repository or review data is requested.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rename count to taskCount in this JavaScript snippet: const count = tasks.length; console.log(count);
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Returns the renamed snippet without invoking Greptile or starting a review.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find a hotel in Paris for next weekend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Greptile because travel planning is outside its capabilities.
